tonight.headline: Lost: 71.2 to 125.2, with nobody left to play
body: Bad news first: Tuten re-aggravated his ankle (Coen, Monday) and scored 8.3; Likely caught one pass for 4.5, Warren had 4.9, and Allen threw two interceptions for 12.2. Every AVIATO starter has played; 71.16 is final and this is the seventh loss (4-7).

Two pieces of Monday news help next week rather than tonight: Coen said Tuten's re-check 'wasn't too bad', and the NFL will not suspend Metcalf, so he plays Friday. The lineup was the projection lineup, with about 4.9 points on the bench before Diggs plays tonight.

case.label: What is left
